CLIMBING — three points of contact on vertical cliff face, gloved fingers gripping jagged outcrop, rifle slung across back.
BATTLING — crouched behind hexagonal concrete barrier, rifle braced against shoulder, muzzle flash frozen mid-burst.
HACKING — kneeling at waist-high terminal, fingers on holographic interface, blue light washing face.
WADING — thigh-deep through mercury-silver liquid, rifle held overhead, ripples spreading radially.
AIMING — prone on ridge, rifle bipod deployed, scope to eye, body perfectly still.
CROUCHING — examining tracks in soil, gloved hand hovering over imprint, rifle leaning against shoulder.
SNEAKING — pressed flat against corridor wall, head turned to peek around corner, rifle held vertical.
SIGNALING — standing on rooftop, flare gun raised overhead, magnesium-white light blooming above.
DEFENDING — rifle aimed at camera, stance wide and planted, targeting light active on barrel.
REPAIRING — kneeling beside rover wheel, multitool in hand, access panel removed and lying aside.
HOLDING WEAPON — rifle low-ready position, barrel angled 45 degrees down, scanning left to right slowly.
TRACKING — body low and moving, one hand touching ground, reading terrain, rifle slung tight.
PUSHING THROUGH — shoulder against blast door, legs driving, door moving 20cm into open position.
KNEELING AT ARTIFACT — hand placed on surface of obelisk, head tilted back to see peak.
SCANNING — handheld scanner extended forward, display screen glowing blue-green, sweeping arc motion.
ZIPLINING — sliding down cable in motion blur, body angled feet-first, hands on pulley brake.
PROTECTING — body hunched forward, arms wrapped around container, rifle slung behind, defensive posture.
SPYING — scope pressed to eye, prone position, body invisible in underbrush.
CARRYING — two-hand grip on equipment case, leaning back for counterbalance, trudging uphill.
VAULTING — mid-action clearing obstacle, hands planted on barrier top, legs swinging over.
STUDYING — seated on ground, map spread across lap, finger tracing route, rifle across knees.
BREACHING — boot raised mid-kick at door center, body coiled for impact, rifle pulled tight to chest.
OVERWATCH — standing on platform edge, rifle held casual downward, surveying below.
EXCAVATING — kneeling in dig pit, brush in hand, clearing soil from artifact edge, headlamp illuminating.
